fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Borehole Heat Exchanger + g-function Ground Coupling
source: Eskilson (1987) Thermal Analysis of Heat Extraction Boreholes (PhD, Lund); Hellström (1991) Ground Heat Storage: Thermal Analyses of Duct Storage Systems (Lund); Claesson & Javed (2011) ASHRAE Trans. finite line source; Nordell (1994) Borehole Heat Store Design Optimization.

unit.name: Generic Seasonal BTES Field — Physics-Lumped (single equivalent borehole)

N_boreholes.note: Number of boreholes in the field

R_b.note: Borehole thermal resistance fluid->wall, Hellström (1991) single-U-tube

mdot.note: Circulating fluid mass flow per borehole

V_store_factor.note: Storage-volume packing factor; V_store = factor * N * B^2 * H (cylinder-in-square)

Q_fluid_W.note: Total field thermal power; + = charge (inject heat), - = discharge
